CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.consume_native_business_api_quota_v1(p_api_key_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef('public.consume_business_api_quota(uuid)'::regprocedure),'UTF8')),'hex')
   IS DISTINCT FROM '51d70f9e682f87017cccd782b9cf944da4bf2790c8472c322472122b4e1f9a69' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'NATIVE_QUOTA_ADOPTION_REQUIRED';
 END IF;
 RETURN public.consume_business_api_quota(p_api_key_id);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.technology_five_job_snapshot_v1(j technology_five_jobs)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',j.id,'catalog_id',j.catalog_id,'engine_id',j.engine_id,'technical_version',j.technical_version,'status','completed','input_rows',j.input_rows,'output_rows',j.output_rows) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.technology_five_publication_snapshot_v1(p_engine text, p_slug text, p_version integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN PERFORM id FROM public.calculator_catalog_admin WHERE calculator_key=p_engine AND slug=p_slug AND version=p_version AND lifecycle='published' FOR SHARE; RETURN FOUND; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.technology_five_require_publication_v1(p_catalog integer, p_version integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE engine text;slug text;
BEGIN
 SELECT t.engine,t.slug INTO engine,slug FROM (VALUES(370,'technology.bandwidth','bandwidth-calculator',1),(371,'technology.download-time','download-time-calculator',1),(372,'technology.upload-time','upload-time-calculator',1),(373,'technology.data-transfer','data-transfer-calculator',1),(386,'technology.base64-size','base64-size-calculator',1),(374,'technology.storage-conversion','storage-conversion-calculator',1),(377,'technology.aspect-ratio','aspect-ratio-calculator',1),(378,'technology.resolution','resolution-calculator',1),(379,'technology.dpi','dpi-calculator',1),(382,'technology.power-supply','power-supply-calculator',1),(383,'technology.website-bandwidth','website-bandwidth-calculator',2),(384,'technology.cloud-storage-cost','cloud-storage-cost-calculator',1),(385,'technology.cloud-data-transfer-cost','cloud-data-transfer-cost-calculator',1))t(catalog,engine,slug,version) WHERE t.catalog=p_catalog AND t.version=p_version;
 IF NOT FOUND OR NOT public.technology_five_publication_snapshot_v1(engine,slug,p_version) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Exact publication unavailable' USING ERRCODE='PT404';END IF;
END $function$
